title: Magic Toad Incense Cone Holder
seo_title: Toad Incense Cone Holder | Resin Incense Burner | Moonpetal
seo_desc: A resin toad in a pointed hat holds your incense cones and sends the smoke curling past his warty little smile. Part of the Moonpetal incense corner.
body:
A resin toad incense cone holder with a pointed hat, for the kind of household where even the amphibians are up to something. Light a cone, set it in place, and watch the smoke wind past his warty, unbothered smile. He keeps company beautifully with the Potion Bottle Incense Cone Holder — same shelf, same mischief.

  • Material: Resin
  • Use: Incense cones (not included)

A resin potion bottle incense cone holder that turns an ordinary cone into something quietly brewing. The smoke rises through the bottle’s neck like a spell mid-thought — decorative even cold, theatrical the moment it’s lit. Conspires happily with the Magic Toad Incense Cone Holder one shelf over.

  • Material: Resin
  • Use: Incense cones (not included)

  • Set: Hollow Library

title: Black Rose Candle — Twilight Blush
seo_title: Black Rose Scented Candle | Gothic Candle | Moonpetal
seo_desc: The Twilight Blush candle from the Black Rose set: dark florals in a moody glass. Part of Moonpetal’s gothic-romantic candle corner.

A Black Rose scented candle in Twilight Blush, for evenings that deserve better lighting. Dark florals, a low glow, and the general feeling of a love letter that was never sent. It burns beautifully alone, and even better beside its siblings — the Sculpted Roses candle and the Black Rose Incense Library.

  • Set: Black Rose

A set of 18 Black Rose incense stick packs in a coffin display — the complete dark-floral library, housed exactly as dramatically as it deserves. Keep the coffin on the counter and pull a pack whenever the room needs a mood. For the devoted: the Black Rose candles burn in the same key.

title: Black Rose Candle — Sculpted Roses
seo_title: Black Rose Candle with 3D Roses | Gothic Decor | Moonpetal
seo_desc: A scented candle crowned with sculpted black roses — half candle, half centrepiece. From Moonpetal’s Black Rose set.
body:
A Black Rose scented candle with sculpted 3D roses, which is to say: a candle that would still earn its place unlit. The moulded blooms sit dark and velvety on top until flame slowly takes them — dramatic, a little tragic, entirely the point. It keeps candlelit company with Twilight Blush from the same set.

  • Material: Scented wax, sculpted rose top
  • Set: Black Rose

title: Frightful Folk Amber Jar Candles — Set of 3
seo_title: Amber Jar Candles Set of 3 | Halloween Candles | Moonpetal
seo_desc: Three Frightful Folk candles in amber glass jars — a matched trio of small warm glows for dark evenings. By Moonpetal.
body:
A set of three Frightful Folk amber jar candles, because one small glow is cosy but three is a séance of the friendliest kind. The amber glass throws a warm, old-lantern light that flatters every shelf it lands on. Scatter them down a mantel or cluster them on a tray and let the evening arrange itself.

  • Contents: 3 candles
  • Material: Amber glass, scented wax
  • Set: Frightful Folk

title: Peekaboo Ghost Candle — Vanilla
seo_title: Ghost Candle Vanilla Scented | Cute Halloween | Moonpetal
seo_desc: A vanilla-scented glass candle with a peekaboo ghost print — the least frightening haunting available. From Moonpetal.
body:
A vanilla scented glass candle with a peekaboo ghost, for hauntings of the gentlest order. The little ghost peers over the glass while warm vanilla does the actual possessing of the room. Sweet enough for year-round burning, seasonal enough to headline October. Pairs mischievously with the Trick or Sweet candle.

  • Material: Glass, scented wax
  • Scent: Vanilla

title: Witching Hour Candle — Plum and Black Cherry
seo_title: Plum Black Cherry Candle | Dark Fruity Scent | Moonpetal
seo_desc: The Witching Hour candle: plum and black cherry in a moody glass jar. Late-night fruit, low light. From Moonpetal.
body:
A plum and black cherry scented glass candle for the hour when the house finally goes quiet and belongs to you again. The scent is dark-fruited and a little indulgent — less orchard, more velvet armchair. Light it at eleven, thank us at midnight.

  • Material: Glass, scented wax
  • Scent: Plum and black cherry

title: Of Whiskers and Wings Candle — Lavender

seo_desc: A lavender glass tube candle in the Of Whiskers and Wings print — cats, bats and calm in one glow. From Moonpetal.
body:
A lavender scented glass tube candle in the Of Whiskers and Wings print, where the cats and bats on the glass are considerably more energetic than the scent inside. Lavender does its slow, honest work while the print keeps things playful. A soft-glow companion for reading corners and wind-down rituals of the entirely secular kind.

  • Material: Glass, scented wax
  • Scent: Lavender

title: Opium Scented Tea Lights

seo_desc: Opium-scented tea lights: small flames, heavy atmosphere. Scatter them everywhere and let the evening do the rest. By Moonpetal.
body:
Opium scented tea lights — small candles with a disproportionate sense of drama. The fragrance is warm, resinous and vaguely nocturnal, and because they’re tea lights you can deploy them by the handful: windowsills, trays, the good lantern. Atmosphere by the dozen.

  • Type: Scented tea lights
  • Scent: Opium

title: Trick or Sweet Candle — Candy Apple
seo_title: Candy Apple Candle | Cute Halloween Print | Moonpetal
seo_desc: A candy-apple scented tube candle in a cute Halloween print — sugar first, spooky second. From Moonpetal.
body:
A candy apple scented glass tube candle in a cute Halloween print, for those who take their October sweet rather than sinister. It smells like the fairground end of Halloween — toffee-bright, a little nostalgic — while the printed glass handles the festive dressing-up. The Peekaboo Ghost candle makes an excellent partner in crime.

  • Material: Glass, scented wax
  • Scent: Candy apple

A display of 18 Arabian Nights incense gift sets, each one a small, spiced story ready to hand over — or hoard, no judgement. The fragrance leans warm and golden, all dusk markets and slow evenings. Keep the display stocked by the till of your life: one for a friend, one for the house, repeat.

  • Scent: Warm spiced

A set of 12 Midnight Hare wild tulip incense stick packs, for a floral that keeps late hours. Wild tulip is a gentler, greener bloom than the usual suspects — the scent equivalent of a garden at moonrise, hare optional but implied. Twelve packs deep, it will keep the ritual going for months.

  • Contents: 12 incense stick packs
  • Scent: Wild tulip

A set of two Inhale, Exhale incense stick packs — peppermint and eucalyptus — for rooms that have been holding their breath all week. This is the crisp end of the incense shelf: cool, clearing, faintly medicinal in the best spa-day sense. Light one before yoga, after cleaning, or whenever the air needs telling to relax.

  • Contents: 2 packs: peppermint, eucalyptus
  • Type: Incense sticks

A Tutti Frutti incense stick collection set, for days when the house wants sunshine on demand. The assortment runs bright and juicy — a fruit bowl’s worth of moods in stick form — and makes an easy antidote to our otherwise devotedly moody shelves. Somebody in the house will claim a favourite by Friday.

  • Contents: Assorted fruity incense sticks
  • Type: Incense sticks

seo_desc: Two packs of Italian Summer incense — citrus terraces and long lunches, in stick form. From Moonpetal.

A set of two Italian Summer incense stick packs, for importing a terrace afternoon into any postcode. The scent is sun-warmed and citrus-edged — long lunch, lemon grove, someone laughing two tables over. Burn it in February as an act of defiance.

  • Contents: 2 incense stick packs
  • Type: Incense sticks

  • Scent: Orange blossom

  • Set: Dark Romance

A conversation piece that also happens to glow.

A luna moth paper gift bag, for gifts with a touch of moonlight about them. The moth spreads pale green wings across the paper and instantly promotes whatever’s inside to “thoughtful.” Too pretty to throw away, which is rather the idea.

A forest bee paper gift bag, for presents delivered with appropriate industriousness. The bees go about their printed business while the bag goes about its practical one: sturdy paper, proper handles, no wrapping skills required. Honey-sweet without a drop of stickiness.

A Sweet & Spooky print paper gift bag, for treats given in the friendliest season of frights. The print keeps its ghosts smiling and its pumpkins round, striking that ideal October balance: charming on the doorstep, festive on the shelf. Stock up — spooky season is famously generous.
